name: 126. Anthropic/Gemini Responses status + max_output_tokens truncation (#7601)
description:
Issue #7601: on /v1/responses the direct anthropic/* and gemini/* providers returned no `status` on any turn, and a turn cut short by max_output_tokens was indistinguishable from a complete one: no incomplete_details, and the stream terminal was response.completed. /v1/chat/completions for the same request reported finish_reason "length", so the signal was available.

Root cause: AnthropicMessageResponse.ToBifrostResponsesResponse / the message_stop branch of AnthropicStreamEvent.ToBifrostResponsesStream (core/providers/anthropic/responses.go) and GenerateContentResponse.ToResponsesBifrostResponsesResponse / closeGeminiOpenItems (core/providers/gemini/responses.go) set StopReason but never Status/IncompleteDetails, and hard-coded the terminal event to response.completed. Folder 17 pins the same contract for Bedrock (#4679 / #4680).

Cases per provider: (1) truncated non-streaming -> status incomplete + incomplete_details.reason max_output_tokens; (2) truncated streaming -> response.incomplete terminal, never response.completed; (3) short complete turn -> status completed. The Anthropic converter is shared by Vertex/Azure/Bedrock-Claude and others, and the Gemini one by Vertex, so these pin the shared path.

The Gemini streaming case sends reasoning.effort "none" (thinkingBudget 0): with thinking on, gemini-2.5-flash spends the whole 16-token budget on thoughts and its streaming endpoint then returns a 200 with an empty SSE body (no finishReason at all), so there is no truncation signal for the gateway to translate.
